title: Argo CD 6: Multi-Tenancy, RBAC, and Trusting What You Deploy
description: Lock a tenant into one repository and one set of namespaces, write an RBAC policy and find the leak the default setting leaves open, let a tenant own Applications in their own namespace without touching argocd, then seal a secret for Git and require signed commits before anything deploys.
